root_cause: bevindingen.js ranked external findings (branchenormen, onderzoek, regelgeving met datum) but they were not converted to contextual action cards. komendeVerplichtingen was defined and never registered; the normen page id 'mensen-organisatie' did not exist; regelgeving ignored the client's branch.
fix: portal-v2/external-signal-actions.js turns bevindingen with extern provenance into contextual cards on every relevant existing page, with source, peildatum, herzienUiterlijk and reden. Stale sources drop one priority level. Regulation follows the branch. bg_externe_signalen rows pass through a strict adapter (toegestaan, vertrouwen >= 0.6, valid deadline, https) and are never tenant-verified.
prevention_rule: An external finding is shown on each portal page it affects, with its source and date. It never becomes a euro conclusion or a legal determination, and it never gets its own scoring model.

invariants: no external card without own client data
every external card carries bron, peildatum, herzienUiterlijk and reden
stale source drops one level and is labelled
regulation not affecting the branch yields no card
every finding points at an existing page
